title: helianthemum variabile var. hololeucum
intro: Helianthemum variabile var. hololeucum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Western Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat a range of health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The health benefits of Rockrose include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating stress, making it a popular herbal remedy in natural medicine.
